steps.name: sizing-fix-proof
steps.eval: (async()=>{const M=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shader-mount.js?v=6');const F=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shaders/mesh-gradient.js?v=6');const S=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/shader-sizing.js?v=6');const C=await import('/libs/paper-shaders/get-shader-color-from-string.js?v=6');const SIZING={u_fit:S.ShaderFitOptions[S.defaultObjectSizing.fit],u_scale:S.defaultObjectSizing.scale,u_rotation:S.defaultObjectSizing.rotation,u_offsetX:S.defaultObjectSizing.offsetX,u_offsetY:S.defaultObjectSizing.offsetY,u_originX:S.defaultObjectSizing.originX,u_originY:S.defaultObjectSizing.originY,u_worldWidth:S.defaultObjectSizing.worldWidth,u_worldHeight:S.defaultObjectSizing.worldHeight,u_imageAspectRatio:1};const colors=['#eef1fd','#8ea5f7','#3e63dd','#9b6fd6','#f6c67a'].map(C.getShaderColorFromString);const base={u_colors:colors,u_colorsCount:5,u_distortion:0.85,u_swirl:0.26,u_grainMixer:0.14,u_grainOverlay:0.05};const run=(uniforms)=>{const host=document.createElement('div');host.style.cssText='position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:240px;height:160px;opacity:0.01;pointer-events:none';document.body.appendChild(host);return new Promise((res)=>{const m=new M.ShaderMount(host,F.meshGradientFragmentShader,uniforms,{preserveDrawingBuffer:true},0.6,0,1,240*160);setTimeout(()=>{const gl=m.gl,w=m.canvasElement.width,h=m.canvasElement.height;const px=new Uint8Array(w*h*4);gl.readPixels(0,0,w,h,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,px);const sum=[0,0,0],min=[255,255,255],max=[0,0,0];let n=0,sq=0;for(let i=0;i<px.length;i+=4*5){const r=px[i],g=px[i+1],b=px[i+2];sum[0]+=r;sum[1]+=g;sum[2]+=b;for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const v=px[i+k];if(v<min[k])min[k]=v;if(v>max[k])max[k]=v;}const lum=0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b;sq+=lum*lum;n++;}const mean=sum.map(s=>Math.round(s/n));const ml=0.2126*mean[0]+0.7152*mean[1]+0.0722*mean[2];const out={mean,min,max,meanLum:Math.round(ml),sdLum:Math.round(Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,sq/n-ml*ml))),alphaSample:Array.from(px.slice(0,4))};m.dispose();host.remove();res(out);},1100);});};const without=await run(base);const withSizing=await run(Object.assign({},base,SIZING));const A=window.NestArt||{};const band=document.querySelector('[data-art-shader="band"]');const bm=band&&band.paperShaderMount;return JSON.stringify({page:location.pathname,nestArtVersion:A.v,state:A.state,canvases:A.canvases,withoutSizing:without,withSizing:withSizing,bandParentHasMount:!!bm,bandFrame:bm?Math.round(bm.currentFrame):null,bandCanvasSize:bm?[bm.canvasElement.width,bm.canvasElement.height]:null});})()
